visualCharacteristics.structure: single collapsible row: title bar with chevron + paragraph body

contentPattern: One row per collapsible item: cell 1 = label text ('How to play this card'); cell 2 = rich-text body (paragraphs, bold text, ordered/unordered lists). Items render collapsed by default.
reuseGuidance: Use for one or a few full-width collapsible bars (e.g. 'How to play this card' on ticket detail pages). Built on native <details>/<summary>, so it is keyboard and screen-reader accessible without extra script.
